source_semantics_partial.inputs: Documented predictions batch with two dimensions and exactly1000 scores per row; top is documented integer with default5. Source does not validate every top value.
source_semantics_partial.order: Read/validate preds.shape first, then lazily fetch/cache class index metadata, then convert to NumPy, argsort/slice/reverse per row, build label-score tuples and Python-sort tuples descending by score.
source_semantics_partial.metadata: CLASS_INDEX is process-global mutable cache. First use calls get_file for imagenet_class_index.json with literal source hash, reads JSON and retains mapping; no asset fetch occurred here.
source_semantics_partial.numeric: No source normalization/softmax occurs. Ranking, ties, NaNs, score dtype and unusual top values remain distinct obligations. Shape access precedes conversion, so automatic conversion cannot hide shape/type failures.
source_semantics_partial.outputs: A list per batch row containing class-code, class-description and score tuples. Output score type follows converted NumPy values; no tested output-dtype equivalence is asserted.
source_semantics_partial.conversion_device: ops.convert_to_numpy is explicit source behavior; symbolic/graph/JIT and device transfer behavior remain unqualified. Host materialization or CPU execution cannot qualify accelerator parity.
source_semantics_partial.gradient: Discrete ranking/label output and conversion boundaries require explicit non-differentiable/disconnected-gradient semantics; no gradient qualification occurs.
